package.name: mujoco_vendor
package.description: Drop-in replacement for pal-robotics/mujoco_vendor that wraps an already installed MuJoCo binary SDK (default: $MUJOCO_DIR, $MUJOCO_PY_MUJOCO_PATH or /opt/.mujoco/mujoco-3.5.0) instead of downloading one. Exposes the same CMake targets/variables (mujoco::mujoco, mujoco::libmujoco_simulate, lodepng, MUJOCO_*_DIR).
